Bihar Police CSBC Constable GD Final Result 2026 – Out – Full Details

Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC) has released the Final Result for the post of Constable (General Duty Close Cadre). This recruitment was released for 83 posts. Applications for the Bihar Police CSBC Constable GD Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 06 February 2026 to 05 March 2026. The PST/DV examination was conducted on 12 September 2026. Candidates who have appeared for this exam can download their Bihar Police CSBC Constable GD Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 February 2026
  • Last Date : 05 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 June 2026
  • Exam City Details Available : 11 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 18 June 2026
  • Result : 18 August 2026
  • PST/DV Exam Date : 12 September 2026
  • PST/DV Admit Card Date : 05 September 2026
  • Final Result : 09 October 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
